_readme: TEST FIXTURE mirroring the SHAPE of the delivered canon (allowed_tool_types
= transfer_call + end_call). It is not the canon itself and is not kept in
sync automatically: it exists so the enabled-set filter can be tested for
'blocks what is not listed' without the platform repo being checked out.
The real canon is deploy/feature-scope.json in the platform repo. Tests that
must assert against the real thing point PLATFORM_FEATURE_SCOPE at it.
